name: Residence Visa (Family)

requirements.blocker_text: Must be a spouse, or a foreign-national child, of a Sri Lankan citizen.

evidence_required.document: Sponsor's proof of Sri Lankan citizenship

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source located in this build

sources.title: Department of Immigration & Emigration, Sri Lanka -- General Information on Visa: Residence Visa's Family subcategory covers spouses and foreign-national children of Sri Lankan citizens

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Sri Lanka). Published on tier-1 sourcing, though only at the category-name level -- duration and fee detail were not specified in the source retrieved. This is the residence route a foreign spouse actually lives on day-to-day while accumulating the 1 year of residence needed to apply for citizenship by registration under lk_citizenship_by_marriage.json. Gender-neutral on its face ('spouses'), consistent with lk_citizenship_by_marriage.json's own gender-neutral wording.
